issue_context.title: PodGC unit tests do not actually test addition of any conditions.
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

We should enhance the podgc_controller_test.go to verify that adding `DisruptionCondition` is unit-testable.

We originally thought that this would only be possible with finalizers but there looks to be other options.  

We could follow examples from https://github.com/kubernetes/cloud-provider-gcp/blob/d716fdd45233c59b10fb76d5b72964cb8ec6d398/cmd/gcp-controller-manager/node_csr_approver_test.go#L1649.  

### Why is this needed?

In podgc, if we discover an orphaned pod (pod on a missing node), we add a DisruptionCondition to the pod.  

We only test this behavior in the integration tests because we previously rely on finalizers to halt the deletion so we can avoid flaky tests.
